item.title: Indian Society of Advertisers names Atul Agrawal as CEO
item.description: The Indian Society of Advertisers (ISA) has appointed Atul Agrawal as its Chief Executive Officer, effective January 2, 2026. ISA represents advertisers in India and has been in operation for more than seven decades. item.title: Varun Nair joins Lumio as Head of Marketing
item.description: Consumer electronics brand Lumio has appointed Varun Nair as its Head of Marketing, as announced on Monday. In the role, Nair will oversee the brand’s marketing efforts and its go-to-market strategy. Nair has more than a decade of experience in brand strategy, media, digital marketing and community building. item.description: Indian marketers are shifting from experimenting with artificial intelligence to using it at scale, with a growing focus on solving business problems rather than testing creative possibilities. After initial trials in 2024 and wider adoption in 2025, marketers are now using AI to link consumer discovery more closely with sales and efficiency. item.title: Reddit introduces AI-powered 'Max campaigns' with new audience insights
item.description: Reddit has introduced a new automated advertising campaign format, called Max campaigns, which is now available in beta to select advertisers. The platform said the move comes as activity on it continues to grow. item.title: WPP introduces Agent Hub for AI-driven marketing functions
item.description: WPP has launched Agent Hub, a new internal application on its marketing AI platform, WPP Open, aimed at centralising and scaling the agency’s functions through artificial intelligence. Agent Hub functions as an internal app store that houses AI agents built using WPP’s proprietary data, strategic frameworks and internal best practices.
